punatech-2026.title: Puna Tech 2026
punatech-2026.subtitle: AI Congress
punatech-2026.summary: Speaker, mentor, and staff at Puna Tech 2026. Talk on AI applied to agriculture, AI agents, and blockchain with real use cases from Northwest Argentina.
punatech-2026.context: Puna Tech 2026 brought Salta and northern Argentina's tech community together for three days focused on AI. On the 28th and 29th, the Ideathon and Hackathon ran at the Escuela de Emprendedores and Centro Cultural Dino Saluzzi; on Saturday the 30th there were talks, an expo, and parallel rooms. It was a landmark gathering to broaden access to artificial intelligence tools in the province.

alt.yospeaker: Talk on AI applied to agriculture and blockchain at Puna Tech 2026
alt.fotogrupal: Group photo of the team and community at Puna Tech 2026
alt.premiospuna: Awards and closing ceremony at Puna Tech 2026

speaker.title: My role as speaker
bullets: Delivered a talk on AI designed for and applied to agriculture, focused on the productive context of Northwest Argentina.
Defined what AI agents are and presented real-world use cases that can already be implemented in the region.
Explained how blockchain properties — traceability, immutability, and distributed trust — can support key aspects of the agricultural sector.

mentor.title: My role as mentor
bullets: Supported teams during the Ideathon and Hackathon in problem framing and MVP scope.
Helped prioritize deliverables, split tasks, and prepare the final jury pitch.
Provided technical feedback on stack choices, feasibility, and how to present the solution.

staff.title: My role as staff
bullets: Helped run the event with SaltaDev so all three days ran smoothly.
Supported logistics, coordination between rooms, and participant assistance.
Took part in pre-event planning and wrap-up as part of the staff team.

punatech-2026.outcome: Puna Tech established a regional hub for AI with over 1,500 attendees. It was a full-circle experience — outreach, mentoring, and operations — that ties directly into my work at SaltaDev and on AI-powered solutions.

seo.title: Puna Tech 2026 | Agustín Juárez
seo.description: Speaker at Puna Tech 2026: talk on AI applied to agriculture, AI agents, and blockchain in Northwest Argentina. Mentor, staff, Ideathon, and Hackathon in Salta.

zafra.title: Zafra
zafra.subtitle: Agentic AI for agricultural management and optimization
zafra.problem: Producers in Northwest Argentina need faster decisions with data scattered across livestock, crops, and weather.
zafra.role: Designed and implemented the agentic system: sub-agent orchestration, satellite integration, and Telegram channel.
zafra.description: Agentic AI system for farm management with alerts and Telegram chat.
zafra.context: Zafra was created to bring applied AI to the field in northern Argentina. Instead of rigid dashboards, it offers an ecosystem of agents that interpret territorial data, coordinate specialized sub-agents, and return actionable answers to producers and technical teams.
highlights: Agentic architecture with sub-agents for agriculture and livestock in one flow.
Satellite data integration for monitoring and early detection of critical events.
Configurable alerts based on business thresholds and field conditions.
Conversational assistance via Telegram for low-friction queries and follow-up.
Designed around real use cases in Northwest Argentina, not lab-only prototypes.
zafra.outcome: Zafra strengthens my AgTech and applied AI work: a product built for the territory, connecting satellite insight with daily decisions and broader access to intelligent tools for agriculture.
